City Centre Station is a station on Centre Line. It is operated by Earn Island Light Rail, and is located at Los Sengas Earn Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway Interisland Line, Gondola Line (Earn Island Station) and Peckern Transit Northland Line (Earn Island Station) for external access.

Fun Facts[]

  • Despite the fact that the exits and the platforms are located at ground level, the exits are not directly accessible from the platforms, and passengers have to make use of exit passageways at L1 to leave the station.

City Origin Station NR Dex (Back)

City Origin Station is a station on New Edward Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at the east edge of Los Sengas Downtown near Katadelphia. Passengers may also use this station to change to Katadelphia Railway Lincity Line (Origin Forest Station) and Line 301 City Origin NR Station, Origin Forest stops. Alternatively, passengers may also use the Origin Underground Street to connect to Nazca Railway East Ring Line (Origin Pond Station), Stadium Line, Arcgo Line, Origin Line (Origin Station) and Pegasus Line (Origin Court Station).

History[]

  • June 1 2015: This station began services.
  • May 12 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • August 16 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[5]
  • May 22 2022: A covered walkway is added at Exit A to connect this station with Origin Underground Street and Origin Court Station.[6]
  • May 23 2022: Exits of this station are named.[7]
  • September 13 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]
  • September 25 2024: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[9]

Citybranch Line is one of the lines in Period 4 of the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It runs between Ne Island and Hatace Island, and currently has six stations. This line began services on April 2 2018.

Contents

  • 1 Fun Facts
  • 2 List of Stations
  • 3 Gallery
  • 4 Citations and References

Fun Facts[]

  • Original plnas of this line involved extensions to Peckern Continent in the west and Cometsilk in the east.
  • This Line is built as an auxiliary line between Islands in West Metropolis Archipelago, and it is unlikely that this line will see further expansions.
  • Among all the lines involved in Period 4 of the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme, this line had the longest construction timespan.

  • The Design of this station alludes to Purplaetus Station.[2]

  • A boxing ring exists outside the Exit C of this station.
  • The Chinese name of this station alludes to the Ching Ho Constituency in Hong Kong. However, it is also named after the nearby Ching Ho Village. As the name of that village was inspired from the villagers themselves, the villagers are happy to see the station named after their village.

Clearwave Station is a station on Aquilo Circuit. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Intus Aquilo. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line INN-05 (Clearwave Stop).

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Quiescent Ripple.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Where Cold Order Moves and Night Becomes String".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)

Fun Facts[]

  • The Concourse and Platforms of this Station have ceilings that are slanted upwards from the south to the north.
  • The West end of the Station Concourse also serves as a Public Passage between Exits A and B. Red and Blue Concrete on the floor indicates the North and South Direction respectively, and when the Station closes down, Exits A and B would still remain open.

History[]

  • April 18 2025: This Station began construction.
  • April 20 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • April 22 2025: This Station began services. Aquilo Circuit is established.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Chinese name of this station is a Word Play of Zhong Nanshan, a Chinese Pulmonologist, though was not intentionally named due to word playing; Instead, the station is named to construct a direct contrast with Begnorth Coast Station.
  • Due to the lack of surrounding developemnt at the time of its completion, stations after Evillow Line Arrowhead Station did not feature any exits. However, in order to guarantee that passengers can leave the station, a temporary exit was set up in the middle of Oasis Bay Highway. However, the exit is now demolished following the construction of Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Graydome Station, and the original exit passageway is now modified into the transfer passageway between two stations.
  • Exit B's design resembles a red arrow pointing towards the south and a gray circle, which pays tribute to both Closouth Heights Station and Graydome Station respectively.
  • The glass used in this station alternate between normal Glass and Red Stained Glass, which signals the south side of this station. Similar design has been applied on Begnorth Coast Station Platform 3 and 4 but is not visible to public due to those platforms being sealed off.
  • The station number of Evillow Line for this station was EV-21. However, it has later been changed to EV-23 due to Station Number rearrangements.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station features a total of ten Connecting Passageways (with five passageways for each floor) that provides access between the four platforms and the concourse. This ensures that at least one accessible passageway is available for each platform, as well as independent operations of Pegasus Line and Aquilo Circuit. The design integrates that of Newmonth River, Arcgo West Island and Ribera Harbor Stations, and the function of each connecting passageway is as follows:
    • North Passageway: Connection between Platforms of the same floor, Stair Access to Concourse and the other Platform Level.
    • Mid-North Passageway: Connection between Platforms of the same floor, Elevator Access to Concourse and the other Platform Level.
    • Middle Passageway: Connection between Platforms of the same floor.
    • Mid-South Passageways: Connection between Platforms of different floors in the form of a ramp. There are two such passageways, one between Platforms 1-4, and the other between Platforms 2-3.
    • South Passageway: Connection between Platforms of the same floor, Stair Access to Concourse and the other Platform Level.
  • Colored wool representing Pegasus Line and Aquilo Circuit are used at the Platforms and Concourse of this Station to indicate that the area is located at a closer vicinity to that respective route or is used for that route. A similar design was also used at Markost Station.
  • This Station was not a part of the original 2024 Development Plans, but was added due to Intus Aquilo Development.

History[]

  • May 3 2025: This Station began construction.
  • May 6 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • May 16 2025: This Station began services alongside Aquilo Circuit, and Aquilo Circuit extends from Greenbay Crest Station to Branches' Hallow Station through this station, but Pegasus Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • June 13 2025: Pegasus Line extends from Starykanal Station to this station through Oakstone Heights Station.

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Demolished)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 2
  • Two players are required for this station souvenir.
  • The station souvenir is accessible from the lower concourse, but is blocked off by three different barrier gates. Beneath each barrier gate are different colored wools.
  • While one player proceeds, another player finds pressure plates on the upper concourse that corresponds to the respective colored wool.
  • After passing through all barriers, the station souvenir can be reached.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a stone pressure plate.

Fun Facts[]

  • Among the six stations built in Season 1, Episode 19, this station is the only station that did not have plans to become an interchange with other lines. For the other stations in the same episode, Thick River Station had plans to intechange with East Ring Line, whereas reserved structure for Arcgo Line and Ingress Line are already built for Thin River Station and Ingress South Station respectively, and White Margin Station and East Margin Station are interchangable with each other. However, in spite of this, this station still became a three-line interchange after two expansions.
  • This station used to feature a Station Souvenir. However, it was demolished due to Pegasus Line works.

History[]

  • December 26 2015: This station began services alongside Luxter Line.
  • September 26 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • June 29 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • December 30 2020: This station began expansion of the Swift Line part.[6]
  • January 1 2021: This station completed the first expansion.[7]
  • January 3 2021: Swift Line is established.
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[8]
  • June 23 2022: This station completed the second expansion.
  • June 24 2022: Pegasus Line extends from Pale Rivering Station to this station.
  • September 7 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[9]

Coast Line was the ninth line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between Tremend South Bridge and InGun Taiga, and had a total of 11 stations. It was established alongside InGun Taiga Station on December 4 2013. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

  • 1 Description
  • 2 History

Description[]

Coast Line was the ninth District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled along the north coast of Tremend Sea and the south coast of Terracept Continent.

This line was represented by the Brown Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 8.

At the time of its closure, this route was 14.91 km long, with a total of 11 stations.

History[]

  • December 4 2013: Three Sym - InGun Taiga
  • February 3 2014: Tremend Coast - InGun Taiga
  • April 2 2014: Tremend South Bridge - InGun Taiga (Line Complete)

Fun Facts[]

  • The Chinese Name of this place is a Homophonic Translation of the English Name.[2]
  • The NR Shops of this station are all located at the Platform Level of this station. While Mei Fwong Station also has NR Shops at the platform level, the shops at that station are located to the north of the platforms, whereas the NR Shops at this station face directly towards the platforms.
  • The Station Code of this station had undergone multiple changes. While this station originally planned to use "CON" as the Station Code, which was also the intended station code of Congorge Station, as "CON" is still reserved for the Windows System, "CON" is unusable. While COO and CLO was also considered, COO is already used in Cooace Hill Station, and ultimately, CCC is used as the Station Code. This Station is also the first station in which the station code involves three identical English Letters in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • The footbridge Exits of this station alludes to the Wan Chai North Footbridge System connecting to Wan Chai Station.[3]

History[]

  • March 18 2022: This Station began services.

Combrain Tunnel is an underwater tunnel in NR Los Sengas Division.

Description[]

  • Number of Tubes: 4
  • Length: 965 m
  • Lines Served: New Edward Line, Alpha Line, Bravo Line
  • Location: Compass Island Station - Brain Island Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • This tunnel is the first underwater tunnel with four tubes used by three different lines.

Fun Facts[]

  • Purple Wool is used in this station for the following Reasons:[3]
    • Purple Wool is used as the contrast color th the Yellow Wool of Warm Cairn Station
    • Purple is usually associated with the night, and comets can usually be seen at night.
    • The Purple Comet alludes to a movie called Your Name. It is also implied that the movie is the namesake of Cometsilk as a whole District.
  • In order to allude to the theme of this station, a Comet Station Art is attached on top of the East Ring Line Concourse of this station.

History[]

  • August 20 2017: This station began construction.[4]
  • August 21 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line.
  • February 12 2018: This station completed expansion of the Cometsilk Line section.[5]
  • February 15 2018: Cometsilk Line is established.
  • July 20 2018: This station is chosen as the venue for the Project Nazca sixth anniversary station.
  • August 1 2018: The Sixth Anniversary Commemorative Activity is held at this station.

Cometsilk Line is Line Number 22 of NR Los Sengas Division Standard Railway. It is a Circular Line to the southeast of Los Sengas. This line has 13 stations, was established on February 15 2018, and formed a complete loop on January 28 2022. Moreover, a branch to and from Harvest River is set up between Waterbelt Garden and Shadow Shore, which commenced services on June 2 2019.

Description[]

Cometsilk Line is one of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

This route is represented by Purple on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 22.

This line is 22.89 km long, and has a total of 13 stations.

History[]

  • S3E5: Nail Bight - Echo Cliffs
  • S3I1: Nail Bight - Echo Cliffs (Waterbelt Garden <-> Harvest River <-> Shadow Shore)
  • S3E15: Nail Bight - Nail Bight (Loop Complete, Waterbelt Garden <-> Harvest River <-> Shadow Shore)

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. Named after the fact that this line mainly serves Cometsilk.
  • This line is the third Circular Line in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, and is also the first Circular Line with its own terminus.[3]

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is built to commemorate an administrator in Project Nazca who loves anime and, much like the case with Comic Ward and Pan-ward, is also named Edward. The Red and Blue Wools of this station refer to the fact that most pairs of main characters in Japanese Anime have red and blue color schemes.[6][7] In Los Sengas Division, there are four other stations that are built to commemorate different people in Project Nazca who are named Edward and had contributed to this server, namely Comp Ward, Pan-ward, Edward Island and Ani Ward.
  • The color scheme of Ani Ward Station alludes to this station.
  • The design of Nawis Railway Le Monde Station takes reference from this station.

History[]

  • September 28 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line.
  • October 14 2015: Kinight Line extends from Ani Ward Station to this station.
  • August 25 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[8]
  • January 9 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[9]
  • August 5 2020: The Kinight Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[10]
  • July 5 2021: Exits A and F of this station completed reconstruction.[11]
  • January 18 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is located directly beneath Route 15, and is the first instance of Nazca Railway building a new ground station directly beneath a highway bridge since Dansein Joint Station. The fact that this Ground Station adopts Island Platforms is also similar to that station.
  • Oasis Bay Line features a section that enables passenger to travel directly to Pinewatch. This makes Mount Qin West and Spring Point the third and fourth respective stations that passengers can skip through while riding on the same line, with the first two being Metro Stone of the West Ring Line and Harvest River of the Cometsilk Line. This also marks the first instance where a Through Service is applied within the same line.[2]

title: Comp Ward North Tunnel
safeHtml:
Comp Ward North Tunnel is an underwater tunnel in NR Los Sengas Division.

Description[]

  • Number of Tubes: 4
  • Length: 2852 m
  • Lines Served: New Edward Line, Alpha Line, Bravo Line
  • Location: Edward Island Checkpoint - Comp Ward Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • This tunnel is an underwater tunnel with four tubes used by three different lines.
  • This underwater tunnel has overtaken Upper Bufly Tunnel in length and became the longest underwater tunnel in Los Sengas until the completion of Beltsand Tunnel. However, this tunnel is still the longest 4-tube underwater tunnel in Los Sengas and the longest underwater tunnel for New Edward Line, Alpha Line and Bravo Line.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is built to commemorate one of the creators of Project Nazca who was already active during the Golden Division era, is named Edward, and studied Computer Engineering. It was also implied that he might be the person who caused Fansim Island to have its current name.[4] In Los Sengas Division, there are four other stations that are built to commemorate different people in Project Nazca who are named Edward and had contributed to this server, namely Pan-ward, Comic Ward, Edward Island and Ani Ward.
  • The layout of New Edward Line and Alpha Line Platforms of this station pays tribute to the Skyoar Line and Islands Line Platforms of Mark 4 Station in Terracept Division.
  • The background image of the Chinese Wiki is taken at the New Edward Line and Alpha Line Platforms of this station.
  • This station is the first station in Los Sengas to be designed and built as a three-line interchange station.
  • The Alpha Line section between this station and Metropolis Terminal used to have the longest inter-station distance in Los Sengas Division at 12460m. While this record has since been overtaken by Urban Express between Tat Stone Hill Checkpoint and Metropolis Terminal, this section still remains the longest inter-station distance for any Veloduct in Los Sengas Division.

History[]

  • September 26 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line.
  • November 2 2015: New Edward Line extends from Edward Island Checkpoint (Then Edward Island Station) to this station.
  • August 18 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works. At the same day, Alpha Line is established, and extends from Metropolis Terminal to this station.[5]
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[6]
  • March 18 2022: Exit D is removed from this station, and all remaining exits have been relocated to ground level.[7]
  • December 2 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

title: Compahills Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Compahills Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for Abyss Line. It is located to the east of Compahills Station.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
    • 1.3 Other Facts
  • 2 Gallery
  • 3 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

This siding has six tracks in total, each storing six 9-carriage trains.

Connecting Tracks[]

The two ends of the stabling sidings connect to Abyss Line, with access to Oganesson Station to the north and Rectime Bay Station to the south.

Other Facts[]

This Stabling Siding is located on ground level, and high walls are set up around this stabling siding to prevent breaches into this Stabling Siding and causing potential danger.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station adopts the Spanish Solution.
  • The Compahills Stabling Sidings is located directly to the east of Platform 1 of this station.
  • This station is the highest Ground Station in Nazca Railway.
  • The Exit Passageways, Concourse and Platform arches are all built in a curved fashion to allude to the theme of this station,, which goes in stark contrast to Rectime Bay Station, which is built in a rectangular fashion. The Compass in this station refers to the drawing tool that draws circles.[2]

Fun Facts[]

  • The North side of this station uses red wool as the complimentary building material, whereas the south side of this station uses blue wool as the complimentary building material. This color scheme alludes to a Magnetic Compass, where the north pole is usually red and the south pole is usually blue for identification purposes.
  • This station is the end of the three-line shared track section between Alpha Line, Bravo Line and New Edward Line. However, Alpha Line and Bravo Line still shared tracks until Edward Island Checkpoint.

History[]

  • October 23 2015: This station began services alongside New Edward Line.
  • September 5 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • September 23 2019: This station completed expansion of the Stadow Line Part.[3]
  • September 24 2019: Stadow Line extends from San-loop Station to this station.
  • April 5 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is one of the three stations built to commemorate PeriodSquirrel, a former administrator of Project Nazca who left Project Nazca due to historical reasons, with the other two stations being Perquel Island Station and Squirrel Tail Station. The color scheme of this station alludes to his suit.
  • This station is the first Island Station built in East Ring Line.[2]
  • This station is the third station to be named after a Punctuation Mark, with the first two being Brackox Station and Backcomma Beach Station.
  • While the Platform Screen Doors of this station were originally built with Purple and White Stained Glass[3], they have since been replaced by ordinary glass panes in order to make Stained Glass Platform Screen Doors a characteristic of Group 1 Gateways.

History[]

  • May 10 2017: This station began services.
  • October 15 2020: Exits C and D are added to this station.[4]
  • May 20 2022: Exit D has been relocated to the south by about 20 meters, and has been renamed from "EKEA" to its current name.[5]

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Inaccessible)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 2
  • Find the entrance to the water level beneath the Liquid Platform Screen Doors and swim to the chest.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a chest.

Fifth Anniversary Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0
  • Just walk to the Concourse and get your Souvenir
  • The Fifth Anniversary Souvenir comes in the form of The Door of Courage.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Door of Courage is a special souvenir that could only be obtained from this station.
  • While the original code of this station was meant to be "CON"[3], as "CON" became reserved for the Windows System during the Second Stage Upgrading Works, the station code has now changed to "COG".
  • The Slanted Ceiling of this station pays tribute to Mono Bracket Station in Terracept Division.
  • This station is the first station to ever adopt the Liquid Platform Screen Doors in Los Sengas Division, and the design of the Liquid {SDs alludes to the platform gates at Mangrove Pass Station in Terracept Division.

History[]

  • July 23 2015: This station began services. Daring Line is established.
  • June 9 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • February 18 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • April 15 2022: Exit B of this station is renamed Exit B1, and Exit B2 is added to this station.[6]
  • February 2 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]

Fun Facts[]

  • The Center of the Concourse of this Station features a dome that signifies the Autumn Skies in Hong Kong, with the locations of Glowstone signifying locations of stars. This in turn pays tribute to the Star Chart in the Hong Kong Space Museum.
  • Two separate tables that list out all the 88 IAU Designated Constellations in increasing alphabetical order, with 44 on each table, exist beneath the dome at the center of this concourse.
